text:
jess chen: Quick thought: Console needs a tiny 'defer then fallback' button for noisy spikes. Options: 15s / 60s / 5m. shows trigger and one-sentence reason.
omar farouk: Agree. Triggers: error_rate OR p95 latency. Also want a dry-run toggle so we can see how many requests would've matched.
hana kim: Add tags in audit lines (e.g. model_unreachable, load_spike). Make sampled request ids clickable to open replay. RBAC: only ops can force.
jess chen: When forced, require short operator note. System reasons auto-filled. Email/Slack notify toggle for important routes.
deploy-bot: deploy success: rollout-ui v1.9.3
omar farouk: Telemetry note: store decision_hash + signal snapshot for each event, but sample IDs only to keep costs low.
hana kim: Also add a small chevron to expand full rule JSON for advanced users. OK to prototype?
jess chen: yup, will do mockups and acceptance criteria.
